jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description: <p><strong>Location:</strong> Shanghai, China (Global Engineering Hub) <strong>Position Type:</strong> Full-time | Hands-on Technical Leadership</p> <h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Software Architect</strong>, you will join our core engineering leadership team to drive system design, technical innovation, and architectural excellence across multiple business domains. This is a highly influential, dual-capability role designed for a strategic thinker who actively balances system-wide technical vision with hands-on coding execution.</p> <p>You will dive deep into our systems, identifying technical debt and designing long-term optimization strategies. At the same time, you will remain active in the codebase, building prototypes, delivering features, and establishing standard patterns for our engineering teams. Additionally, you will lead the evaluation and adoption of cutting-edge open-source and commercial solutions to keep our technology stack at the frontier of high-velocity, high-quality development.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>System Architecture &amp; Design:</strong> Own the end-to-end technical architecture for high-impact initiatives across different domains, translating complex commercial goals into robust, scalable, and secure designs.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on Technical Execution:</strong> Maintain a strong presence in the codebase by developing critical components, executing high-value features, and creating functional prototypes to validate design concepts.</li> <li><strong>System Modernization &amp; Tech Debt Management:</strong> Map our legacy applications, identify technical debt, and formulate incremental, cloud-native service decomposition strategies to optimize reliability and reduce complexity.</li> <li><strong>Technical Vendor &amp; Open-Source Evaluation:</strong> Proactively research, audit, and integrate best-in-class third-party software, libraries, and tools from the market to accelerate feature delivery.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Governance &amp; Mentorship:</strong> Define clear service boundaries, API contracts, and database schema standards while mentoring engineering teams on system design best practices and coding discipline.</li> <li><strong>AI-Native Infrastructure Evolution:</strong> Lead the architecture's preparation for AI-native workflows, designing Model Context Protocol (MCP)-ready endpoints and tools to enable automated, agentic code generation and testing workflows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Professional Experience:</strong> 8+ years of software dev

jobs.description: <p>P- 1536</p> <p>At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.</p> <p>The Partner Ecosystem team’s mission at Databricks is to enrich and win customer workloads through seamless integrations with strategic partners, while also widening the partner ecosystem to include new partners and data applications. This team enables seamless connectivity between Databricks and a vast range of partner applications through SQLDrivers. This vital data integration work powers the majority of the company’s Data Warehousing revenue by allowing customers to effortlessly connect their applications to Databricks SQL. In addition to that, through products like Databricks Partner Connect, we are simplifying the discovery and integration process, allowing you to seamlessly incorporate your preferred tools directly within the Databricks platform.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking an experienced Staff / Sr Staff Engineer to join our Partner Ecosystem team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain SQL drivers that power the majority of the data warehousing traffic and critical infrastructure components that power our partner integrations. You'll focus on optimizing SQLDrivers for performance, improved reliability and telemetry to offer seamless connectivity to our partners and enterprise customers, while also maintaining open source repositories and actively engaging with the developer community. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements, architect solutions, and implement robust systems that enable our partners to connect seamlessly to the Databricks platform, ultimately driving Data Warehousing revenue and customer satisfaction.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The impact you'll have:</strong></p> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer working on the Partner Ecosystem team, you will get to build and evolve a set of highly performant and resilient Databricks SQL connectors for partners and enterprise customers enabling them to connect to Databricks SQL seamlessly and derive meaningful insights from data.
